name: Zakariae Bekri
headline:
A little imagination.
A different world.
intro: Objects, spaces and stories. Exploring ideas through 3D, design and digital art.
aboutTitle:
An eye for detail.
A mind for possibility.
about:
I’m Zakariae, a visual designer working across 3D modeling, product visualization and graphic design. I enjoy turning an idea into something you can see, feel and explore.

My background brings together building design training, running my own print shop in Morocco and graphic design work in Qatar. Today, I’m developing my 3D practice and exploring the worlds of games and interactive art.
